These terms are an agreement between you, the shop that uses POSFIX, and [Company name] ([Registration no.]), the company that provides it ("we", "us"). By creating a shop, signing in, or using POSFIX on any device, you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

1. The service

POSFIX is a point-of-sale system for repair shops and small traders, used in a web browser or installed on a phone. It records sales, costs, repair cases (jobsheets), customers, stock and reports, and lets you send customers a receipt or a repair-tracking link.

2. Your account

  • The shop owner signs in with a Google account or an email address and password, and is responsible for everything done under the shop.
  • Staff join a shop with an invite code from the owner and sign in on that device with a PIN. Keep invite codes and PINs private. Remove a device or a staff member as soon as they should no longer have access.
  • The information you give us about your shop must be true.

3. Free period, subscription and payment

  • A new shop may be given a free period. After it ends, continued use needs a paid subscription for one of the packages shown in the admin app, at the price shown there.
  • Payment is made by bank transfer or DuitNow to the account shown, and you upload the payment slip. The subscription starts or is extended once we have checked the payment.
  • If a subscription is not renewed, the shop is locked: staff can no longer use it until it is renewed. Your records are kept, not deleted, while the shop is locked.
  • Fees are not refundable, except where the law requires.

4. Your data

  • The records you key in belong to your shop. You can export them from the admin app at any time.
  • You are responsible for the personal data of your own customers and staff that you record, and for having the right to record it under the Personal Data Protection Act 2010. We process it only to provide the service to you. How we handle personal data is set out in our Privacy Notice.
  • Receipt, job ticket and repair-tracking links you send to a customer can be opened by anyone who has the link. Send them only to the customer they are for.

5. Acceptable use

Do not use POSFIX for anything unlawful, to record data you have no right to hold, to try to reach another shop's data, to interfere with the service or its security, or to resell it without our written consent.

6. Availability and changes

We work to keep POSFIX available and your data safe, but the service is provided "as is". It may be interrupted for maintenance, updates or reasons outside our control. The app keeps working offline and sends what was saved once the connection returns, but you remain responsible for checking your own records. We may improve or change features over time.

7. Liability

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, lost profit or lost business, and our total liability to you for any claim is limited to the fees you paid us in the three months before the claim.

8. Ending the service

You may stop using POSFIX at any time. We may suspend or close a shop that breaks these terms or leaves its subscription unpaid. Ask us if you want your shop's data deleted.

9. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version. Using POSFIX after a change means you accept the updated terms.
